title: Lost Mary BM600 Blackcurrant Apple Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Blackcurrant Apple Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods balance dark berry sharpness with crisp orchard fruit. Tart Blackcurrant leads with rich intensity, while Apple adds sweetness and a bright lift for a balanced all-day vape. Each pack contains two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, offering up to 600 puffs per pod depending on use. Designed for a mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, these pods deliver smooth vapour and consistent flavour without messy refills or coil changes. Compatible with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, the pods are quick to install: just click into place and enjoy the mix of berry and apple notes.
